worldUpdateTimings.note: Top-level parts partition updateWorld; ground details are nested, not additive. Clock reads and capture bookkeeping perturb timing.

titleCadence.method: Reciprocal of the nearest-rank p10 of the first 120 valid visible title callback intervals (4–100 ms); at least 20 samples required.
titleCadence.limitation: Title callback cadence includes loading, scheduling and display pacing. This is not a measured hardware refresh rate.
